boxes.question: Does the answer correctly determine whether the two rows can be made identical after rearranging cards and replacing each @ only with a, t, c, o, d, e, or r?
Does the answer require the counts of every lowercase letter outside {a, t, c, o, d, e, r} to be equal in S and T?
Does the answer correctly account for whether each row has enough @ cards to make up its deficits in the allowed letters?
Does the proposed method handle the input lengths up to 2 × 10^5 without relying on impractical time or memory usage?
